486:t_008:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then we'll blast it away, darkness and all!」

486:t_008:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah! We'll start by taking down whoever comes at us first!」

486:t_008:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hang in there, $$正太郎$$! We'll get $$鉄人$$ back in no time!」

486:t_008:11.en:
$n
「You can do this too, right, $$シンジ$$!」

486:t_008:13.en:
$$アスカ$$
「We're not about to lose to Angels we've already beaten once!」

486:t_008:14.en:
$$マリ$$
(Pfft... You're kind of back to your old self, Princess, nya~)

486:t_008:15.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「First, we hit the Angels at the front line.」

486:t_008:16.en:
$$万丈$$
「Let's go, everyone! We'll become a light that darkness can't defeat!」

486:t_008:17.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$! We'll show you we can dispel the darkness!」

486:t_009:0.en:
$$ギミー$$
「We beat all the Angels, but...」

486:t_009:1.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Is there any way for us to get out of this space...?」

486:t_009:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Think about that later! Here they come again!」

486:t_010:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「So you finally showed yourself, boss of evil!」

486:t_010:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「We've beaten all of your trump cards! Admit defeat gracefully!」

486:t_010:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「We've beaten all of your trump cards! Admit defeat gracefully!」

486:t_010:3.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「We've beaten all of your trump cards! Admit defeat gracefully!」

486:t_010:5.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「This world of darkness will become the source of the power of darkness.」

486:t_011:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「The Angels came back to life again?!」

486:t_012:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Another $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ showed up!」

486:t_012:2.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am... $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 8...」

486:t_012:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The one we fought in the $$多元戦争$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$...!」

486:t_012:7.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「You are the boy from Earth in my last memory...」

486:t_012:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Damn right I am! I'll keep fighting to protect Earth from villains like you!」

486:t_012:10.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Do you still not realize that it is a mistake...?」

486:t_012:11.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Humans are foolish and ugly... They can be called the most evil creatures in this universe.」

486:t_012:13.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Heh heh heh... You deny it desperately, but your heart is full of anxiety.」

486:t_012:14.en:
$$ズール$$
「That computer is right. Darkness lurks in the human heart.」

486:t_012:15.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Hating others, trampling them down, and cursing them for one's own desires...」

486:t_012:16.en:
$$ズール$$
「That becomes darkness and brings death to the world. That is the source of our power.」

486:t_012:18.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I find it unpleasant to watch.」

486:t_013:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And who could laugh at that?」

486:t_013:2.en:
$$カグラ$$
「You bastard! What'd you come here for?!」

486:t_013:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「To watch over your final moments.」

486:t_013:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Shut up! I'm not about to show a punk like you that!」

486:t_013:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Don't bark, winged dog. What can you do in this world of darkness?」

486:t_013:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「If it's pitch black here, I'll light it up!」

486:t_013:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「$$アクエリオン$$ should be able to do it!」

486:t_013:9.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I see! $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$ is the wings of the sun!」

486:t_013:10.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Even in the $$時獄戦役$$, the light of $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$ gave us strength!」

486:t_013:11.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Watch me, $$ミカゲ$$! I'll show you my power!!」

486:t_014:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「It wasn't supposed to be like this...」

486:t_014:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The reincarnation of a winged dog can't do it. That is how deep this darkness is.」

486:t_014:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If you give up here, you're playing right into his hands!」

486:t_014:7.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「That's right, $$アポロ$$! The light of $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$ really did save us back then!」

486:t_014:8.en:
$$アマタ$$
「So let's do it one more time!」

486:t_014:9.en:
$$アポロ$$
「...Heh... It feels weird getting encouraged by my own reincarnation.」

486:t_014:10.en:
$$カグラ$$
「If you get it, then hurry up and do it! Pulling off a comeback at the crucial moment is $$アクエリオン$$'s specialty, isn't it!」

486:t_015:3.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Call him Supreme Commander, $$アポロ$$! Even if he is the reincarnation of someone you know, he is a different person!」

486:t_015:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Old man $$不動$$ is old man $$不動$$! What's wrong with calling him that?!」

486:t_015:6.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Supreme Commander... What did you mean by 'futile'?」

486:t_015:7.en:
$$不動$$
「In the $$時獄戦役$$, $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$ gave off the radiance of the sun because it had gathered people's feelings over 12,000 years.」

486:t_015:8.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Are you saying Solar is out of energy right now?!」
